features.name: RFP start and loading screens
features.line: A clean full-screen title screen and RFP wallpapers on the way to the menu.

features.name: RFP top menu
features.line: A new main menu with the RFP wordmark and slanted highlights; myClub hidden, Multiplayer in its place.

features.name: Six-tab Master League menu
features.line: HOME · MATCHDAY · SQUAD · RECRUITMENT · ACADEMY · CLUB, every screen where you'd look for it. The Youth Team becomes Under 21s; Square saves.

features.name: Club-colour Master League home
features.line: The home menu takes your club's colours, for any club, with a slanted plate on the selected tab.

features.name: More tabs and a restyled home
features.line: More room in the menu, and the home background and panels in the RFP look.

features.name: In-game inbox and newsroom
features.line: An FM-style inbox on the home screen: news from every RFP system, and decisions you answer. The lead story is always the most urgent one.

features.name: Home dashboard
features.line: Next match and table, squad status, scouting, academy and a Data Centre brief for the next match on one screen.

features.name: Button art for your controller
features.line: Button prompts follow your controller setting, PlayStation or Xbox.

features.name: Words, not numbers
features.line: All 25 abilities read as words on a nine-step scale (Poor → World Class). Playing styles and the hexagon stay.

features.name: No OVR
features.line: The overall rating disappears; judge players by what they do.

features.name: Scouted, fuzzy ratings
features.line: Your players are exact; other clubs' players are fuzzy, and a better scouting department makes them clearer.

features.name: New names, real nationality mix
features.line: Retired players come back with a new, nationality-correct name, and clubs sign the mix of nationalities real clubs do. Your youth intake is local.

features.name: Fresh regen profiles
features.line: New position, style, skills and body for every regen, a generic face instead of a retired star's, and skin tone by nationality.

features.name: A unique 3D face for every regen
features.line: Faces and hair generated for each new player from his nationality and family background.

features.name: Name pools for every nationality
features.line: Realistic names for every PES nationality, including players who carry their family's naming tradition.

features.name: Talent that follows the real world
features.line: How good a new player can become depends on his country, his club and its academy, as in real football.

features.name: Eyes and hair by region
features.line: Eye colour, hair colour and eye shape follow nationality.

features.name: Academy levels modelled on real academies
features.line: Eight academy levels, from no academy to the world's best, each with real examples. Spending decides the level, and the level decides how far your scouts reach.

features.name: Youth growth that depends on you
features.line: Youngsters arrive with hidden potential and grow with coaching, facilities, minutes and form.

features.name: Academy players stay to 21
features.line: Academy players stay until 21, then leave as free agents.

features.name: AI academies
features.line: AI clubs develop their youngsters under the same rules as you.

features.name: Truly new players
features.line: Brand-new players created mid-career instead of reusing retired ones.

features.name: Retuned playing styles
features.line: Styles tuned so each one plays more like its real-world type.

features.name: New playing styles
features.line: Playing styles the base game doesn't have.

features.name: Player traits and tendencies
features.line: Per-player traits, and players who lean toward behaviours by degree instead of an on/off style.

features.name: Real club finances
features.line: Matchday, broadcast, commercial, trading and prize money, line by line. What you earn this season funds the next.

features.name: Board budget meeting
features.line: Each pre-season the board sets limits per department; you allocate inside them; what's left becomes your transfer and wage budgets.

features.name: Reputation, TV money and sponsors
features.line: Leagues and clubs ranked by results; broadcast and sponsorship money follow the rank.

features.name: Club departments and facilities
features.line: Academy, scouting, medical, training, stadium and more: fund them, build them up over real build times, or watch them decline.

features.name: Debt, financial rules and AI budgets
features.line: Debt has consequences, UEFA-style rules bite, and AI clubs only buy what they can afford.

features.name: Boards with character
features.line: Every club has an ownership model and a board type, from patient custodians to revolving-door owners.

features.name: Boards that steer AI transfers
features.line: Each AI club buys, sells, loans and renews the way its board wants.

features.name: Boards change
features.line: Elections, takeovers and trustee periods change a club's board mid-career.

features.name: Sackings and hirings
features.line: AI boards sack and hire coaches on their own expectations, at any point of the season.

features.name: Your job on the line
features.line: Your board judges you on the same model, and a new board recruits differently.

features.name: Injuries for every club, from real data
features.line: AI clubs get injured too. Match and training injuries with types and lengths from elite-football data; your medical staff change the odds.

features.name: Rehab and surgery
features.line: Serious injuries need surgery, and players come back through rehab.

features.name: Referees, cards and suspensions
features.line: Fouls, cards and bans that behave like real football, simulated matches included.

features.name: New lower divisions
features.line: Real lower divisions added under existing leagues, with promotion and relegation.

features.name: Running data
features.line: Distance, sprints and heatmaps, per 90 minutes.

features.name: Real-world xG
features.line: Expected goals and post-shot xG from a model trained on real shots.

features.name: Match report
features.line: Pass maps, defensive maps and the full match report, first on a second screen, later in the game.

features.name: Mod data that follows your save
features.line: RFP's career data saves and reloads with the game, and each career keeps its own.

features.line: When youngsters improve in the base game, by how much, and where that can be replaced.
